#018 · Bird Pokémon

Pidgeot

Normal Flying

Kanto · Generation 1

Pidgeot is a Normal/Flying-type Bird Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 39.5 kg. It evolves from Pidgeotto. Its highest base stat is Speed (101), with a base stat total of 479.
